snippet.title: August 23rd Sunday Service
snippet.description:
Feeling weary from everything going on in the world? Are you looking for a sense of normalcy?

Today we welcome our friend Donnie Griggs from North Carolina! Donnie leads a multisite church called “One Harbor” and is also the author of the book “Small Town Jesus: Taking the Gospel Mission Seriously in Seemingly Unimportant Places.” Donnie’s churches are also a part of our extended Newfrontiers International family.

Invite a friend or family member and join us!

#myjubileechurch #onlineservices #everyoneeveryplace #oneharbor #smalltownjesus
